title: Configuration Management Policy
definition: Maintain a library of approved operating system configuration benchmarks to ensure that each of the organization's operating systems is configured securely.

title: Configuration Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the approved operating system configuration benchmark defines the organization's ability to disable all unnecessary operating system services.

title: Configuration Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the approved operating system configuration benchmark requires the organization to define configuration benchmarks for each necessary service, including databases, SMB services, tiny services, VoIP, and similar services.

title: Configuration Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the approved operating system configuration benchmark defines the organization as having unnecessary scripting languages in the operating system.

title: Configuration Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the approved operating system configuration benchmark requires advanced logging for operating system shells, such as Microsoft PowerShell or BASH.

title: Configuration Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the approved operating system configuration benchmark requires enforcement of cybersecurity services such as Data Execution Protection (DEP), Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR), and User Account Control (UAC).

title: Configuration Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the approved operating system configuration benchmark defines the organization's ability to disable autorun on its operating systems.

title: Configuration Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the approved operating system configuration benchmark requires machine locks (screensavers) after a defined period of inactivity.

title: Configuration Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the approved operating system configuration benchmark requires a secure boot process, such as UEFI, to verify the integrity of the operating system before loading.

title: Configuration Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the approved operating system configuration benchmark requires unnecessary wireless protocols and networks to be disabled on the organization's endpoints.

title: Configuration Management Policy
definition: Maintain a library of approved software application configuration benchmarks to ensure that each of the organization's software applications is configured securely.

title: Configuration Management Policy
definition: Maintain a configuration enforcement system to enforce the organization's approved operating system and application configurations on each organizational computing system.

title: Configuration Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the configuration enforcement system enforces approved operating system and application configurations regardless of the computing system's location, whether onsite or operating remotely.
